question:
Select the term from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series based on the English alphabetical order.

SLZ, PHW, ?, JZQ, GVN
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

 
• First and third letter → (3) is subtracted from the position value according to English alphabetic series.
 
• Second letter → (4) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series.

​​So,

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/65fa80c0c989fa06e15ca4849580c9fff723da5902e53a73c7efe47c2d71452f.png] 

Hence, "MDT" is the correct answer.
